subject.title: fix(codex): stop stale MCP child processes with revalidated SIGKILL escalation

question: Should the macOS Codex app-server automatically SIGKILL a still-matching Computer Use MCP child two seconds after SIGTERM?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes the runtime’s process-termination policy; source-level identity checks cannot determine whether forced termination is acceptable for all supported Codex child lifecycles.

options.title: Require owner approval and macOS proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until the Codex lifecycle owner approves the forced-termination policy and the contributor supplies redacted supported-path macOS evidence.

options.title: Retain SIGTERM-only cleanup
options.body: Decline automatic escalation if slow or trapped child shutdown must remain recoverable or diagnostically visible.

recommendation.title: Require owner approval and macOS proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until the Codex lifecycle owner approves the forced-termination policy and the contributor supplies redacted supported-path macOS evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available low-confidence routing candidate for an owner-level runtime policy decision.
